 3 makeup sunscreens that lazy makeup girls can't live without because the finish is so amazing!
 No need for elaborate makeup routines or spending dozens of minutes in front of the mirror; she can still feel confident with a fresh, even-toned, and radiant complexion with just a layer of sunscreen. In particular, the three products below not only protect the skin from UV rays but also score points with their "glass skin" finish, giving the face a naturally radiant look like using a cushion foundation. This is the skincare essential for lazy makeup users.
 Báo Thanh niên • 17/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 
 1. Sakura CC Cream Flawless Control Tone-Up Sunscreen 
 The crown for the best makeup sunscreen goes to this amazing product from the renowned Japanese brand Sakura. It's the top choice for girls who love a fresh, dewy, natural look like they've applied a filter, without spending time on makeup.
 Not only does it boast an SPF50+ PA++++ sun protection factor to safely protect skin from the harmful effects of UVA, UVB, and blue light (the main causes of melasma, freckles, and premature aging), but the product also brightens the skin, provides excellent coverage of imperfections, and gives a natural rosy glow like using a cushion foundation.
 Acne scars, dark spots, and pores are all covered in a very natural style. Especially noteworthy is the brightening effect, giving a healthy, rosy glow without looking pale or greasy. It maintains brightness all day long without fading.
 The cream has a lightweight, mousse-like texture and controls oil quite well, so it stays dry and comfortable on any skin type without clogging pores or causing breakouts. After 1-2 minutes of application, the cream blends into the skin, giving a dewy, radiant finish. 
 Main ingredients: Zinc oxide, titanium dioxide, licorice extract, cherry leaf extract.
 Key advantages: 
 Broad-spectrum sunscreen protects the skin from the harmful effects of UVA, UVB, blue light, etc., which cause dark spots, aging, and maintain healthy, radiant skin.
 Its superior color correction capabilities match skin tone perfectly, cleverly concealing imperfections such as acne, dark spots, large pores, or uneven skin tone, resulting in a natural, rosy white finish that looks like you're wearing makeup.
 It provides essential moisture for a smooth, dewy, and radiant complexion; helping to prevent dry, flaky skin or a patchy foundation that detracts from the overall look.
 It effectively balances excess oil, preventing shine or oiliness, even for oily and acne-prone skin.
 The foundation blends seamlessly into the skin, providing extremely long-lasting color throughout the day, maintaining a rosy complexion for 7-9 hours whether you're in an air-conditioned environment or out in the hot sun or rain.
 Designed specifically for the Vietnamese climate, it stays firmly on the skin regardless of rain or 40-degree heat, without smudging or running.
 The ultra-natural tone-up effect keeps your face radiant all day long without feeling heavy or like you're wearing heavy makeup.
 It also has pretty good water resistance, making it suitable for going to the beach, playing sports , or frequent outdoor activities.
 The gentle ingredient list makes it suitable for many skin types, including sensitive skin, dark skin, and light skin.
 Points to note: There are no flaws, but it's frequently out of stock.
 Overall rating: +10/10.
 Official retail price: 972,000 VND/40ml.

 2. Frezyderm Sun Screen Color Velvet Face SPF 50+ is an oil-controlling tinted sunscreen that helps conceal imperfections. 
 Coming in at number one is a tone-up, blemish-concealing sunscreen from the renowned Greek brand Frezyderm. The product's highlight is its "Second Skin" technology. This technology creates an invisible, smooth film on the skin, providing a comfortable feel.
 This film not only helps the cream absorb quickly without clogging pores, but also optimizes its ability to protect the skin from the harmful effects of UVA, UVB, blue light, infrared rays, etc. At the same time, it creates a blurring effect on wrinkles and blemishes (acne, dark spots, dark circles, etc.), leaving the skin smooth, bright, and evenly toned. Especially noteworthy is its superior oil-controlling ability, preventing shine and making it suitable for outdoor activities. 
 Main ingredients: Octocrylene, titanium dioxide, ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate, diethylamino hydroxybenzoyl hexyl benzoate.
 Key advantages: 
 It protects the skin from four types of rays: UVA, UVB, blue light (HEV), and infrared (IR), maintaining a youthful, bright, and even-toned complexion.
 Stem Cell - DNA Protection technology helps protect the skin from the effects of UV rays and environmental pollutants.
 It has pretty good oil-controlling properties, keeping oily, acne-prone skin clear.
 The cream has a soft, velvety texture, is oil-free, absorbs quickly, and does not leave a sticky residue or white streaks.
 Makeup primer helps to cover imperfections such as wrinkles, acne, blemishes, and dark spots, leaving skin smooth and radiant.
 The tone-enhancing technique is adjusted to suit Asian skin tones, ensuring it's neither excessively white nor too dark, thus maintaining an aesthetically pleasing look.
 Suitable for all skin types, whether oily, acne-prone, sensitive, or even thin and weak skin after peels or laser treatments.
 Point to note: Frequently out of stock in the Vietnamese market.
 Overall rating: 9.5/10.
 Official retail price: 1,045,000 VND/50ml. 
 Guaranteed authentic products with discounts up to 19% here: https://maihan.vn/frezyderm/kem-chong-nang-frezyderm-sun-screen-color-velvet-face-50.html 
 3. Floslek Oil Free Sun Protection Tinted Cream SPF 50+ 
 The top 3 come from the renowned Polish brand Floslek, described as a "skin shield," protecting the skin from the harmful effects of UV rays and environmental factors. They offer moderate coverage and brightening, without clogging pores. 
 You may also like Main ingredients: Octinoxate, uvinul A plus, tinosorb S, niacinamide.
 Key advantages: 
 The oil-free formula keeps skin feeling light and comfortable, preventing clogged pores or breakouts, making it ideal for oily and acne-prone skin.
 Optimal sun protection helps prevent sunburn.
 Lightly brightens skin tone and conceals imperfections for a dewy, radiant, rosy finish without clumping or leaving white streaks.
 Points to note: Skin looks dull and lifeless by the end of the day.
 Overall rating: 7.5/10.
 Official retail price: 618,000 VND/50ml. 
 Don't let your busy schedule steal your daily radiance! Get one of these three "secret weapons" to achieve top-notch sun protection and a smooth, natural-looking finish like professional makeup, all in just one minute.
